Zara CSM: Quasar dedicated bring-up set for Fri 05:45 PST. Need final quota runway, autoscale plan, and a short burnup + soak. Renewal in ~82 days so want clean signal.
Ibrahim SE: What's their traffic shape? steady vs burst and token sizes?
Zara CSM: Customer sent a sweep: steady ~110rps, campaign spikes to ~950rps for 7m, occasional background jobs +30rps. Avg tokens ~140.
Nadia SRE: Recommend runway = 3x steady (330rps) with burst guard to 1.1k for 10m. Require KV priming and prefix warmers pre-test.
Ethan Eng: Draft autoscale: min_replicas=2, target_rps=220, max_replicas=16, scale_step=+3, burst_policy=permit_10m_then-fallback. Will post JSON.
Zara CSM: Test plan: 1) shadow 25m with ramp to peak, 2) routed 12m at 35% traffic if shadow OK. Track p50/p95/p99, 5xx, fallback_count, cache_hit_ratio and token burn.
Ibrahim SE: Load snippet (wrk): `wrk -t4 -c200 -d25m --latency https://api.redwood.test/v1/generate` with ramp controller to reproduce peaks.
opsbot: scheduler: created job qz-2024-999 for 1769996400 (Fri 05:45 PST)
Nadia SRE: Canary rollout: 10% for 30m -> 40% for 1h -> full. Rollback if error delta >0.6% or p99 regresses >300ms.
Zara CSM: Renewal risk rule: if routed soak shows >0.8% 5xx or repeated fallback events, mark as "At-Risk" and open remediation ticket.
Ethan Eng: Posted autoscale JSON: `{ "min":2, "max":16, "target_rps":220, "burst_headroom":1100, "burst_window_mins":10 }`
opsbot: run-complete: qz-2024-999 -> status: shadow_ok, p95: 280ms, p99: 690ms, 5xx: 0.22% (artifacts: s3://quasar/cases/qz-999)
Zara CSM: Shadow looks stable. Scheduling routed soak at 06:30 PST. I'll coordinate enablement and renewal note.
Ibrahim SE: I'll upload scripts and the ramp profile to case QZ-999.
Nadia SRE: I'll monitor cache hit rates during routed soak; if <72% we pause and re-prime.
Zara CSM: Thanks team. Closing after routed soak and artifact upload.
